}}'''Solain Morgeillin''' is one of the [[Kin]].{{ref|{{twotc}}, Solain Morgeillin}}

== Activities ==
Her strength is {{opsl|46}}, strong enough to become Aes Sedai.

She was born in {{ne|818}}, and went to the Tower at {{ne|833}}. She spent 11 years as a novice and 8 as Accepted. However, while she was Accepted, it was discovered that she had kleptomania. She never stole anything valuable, but she could not be broken out of her habit, and was eventually put out of the White Tower for repeated theft.

After she joined the Kin, they persisted and eventually succeeded in breaking her out of her habit. She still retained her skilled fingers, and could slip something out of someone's pocket without leaving a clue.

She didn't care for men at all.

She is sent by [[Reanne Corly]] to the ''[[angreal]]'' cache in [[Ebou Dar]].

She [[Travel]]s with the rest of the Kin from Ebou Dar to the farm and then [[Caemlyn]] in [[Andor]].She is one of the Kin assigned to look after the captive ''[[sul'dam]]''.
